name: Taskiz
oneLiner: Run your contracting business from your phone.
supporting: Customers, jobs, estimates & invoices — one app.
promise: Run the business side of your contracting business from your phone.
adSupport: Customers, jobs, estimates & invoices — one app.
doNotSay: texts and email in one place
photographyStyle: documentary commercial photography, authentic owner-operator contractor, 30s-50s, real residential job site, driveway, or work van interior, natural daylight or golden hour, soft realistic shadows, single clear subject, shallow depth of field, rule of thirds, intentional negative space on one side for later text overlay, clean modern composition — not stock-photo cliché, hands, tools, phone-as-tool (screen not readable), premium but practical, never fashion-editorial
imageNegatives: no text of any kind, no letters, numbers, captions, subtitles, or watermarks, no brand names, logos, or wordmarks on vehicles, clothing, tools, walls, or screens, no "Taskiz" or any product name written in the scene, no fake UI, no unreadable gibberish text on phones, no stock-photo fake smiles, no hard-hat cliché posing for camera, no sci-fi holograms, robots, call-center headsets, neon cyberpunk, no busy collage, no multi-panel, no magazine cover layout, no billboards, no painted logos on vans
compositionNotes: Frame like a premium lifestyle ad still, not a random AI stock image. One hero moment only (one person OR one clear action). Leave clean lower-third or side area empty for design overlay later. Phone may appear but screen content must be blank/blurred/unreadable. Prefer medium shots and over-shoulder; avoid extreme wide empty lots.
